evals.name: messy-multilang-bullets-with-metadata
evals.prompt:
Apunta estas tareas por favor:
- P0 llamar a juan mañana por la mañana #familia #llamada
- estudiar banach 2h por la tarde #matematicas @reflexiones_a_latex
  necesito terminar capítulo 3 antes del miércoles
- comprar pan
- reunion storengy 10:00 low-energy @work
- P1 leer paper topos viernes #topologia #paper
  refs: chat de chatgpt del 2026-04-20 sobre grothendieck
evals.expected_output: Exactly 5 tasks logged. #1: title='llamar a juan', when=tomorrow, time_of_day=morning, priority=P0, tags=[familia, llamada]. #2: title='estudiar banach', when=today, time_of_day=afternoon, duration_min=120, project=reflexiones_a_latex, tags=[matematicas], body contains 'capítulo 3 antes del miércoles'. #3: title='comprar pan', all optional fields null, tags=[]. #4: title='reunion storengy', energy=low, project=work, body contains '10:00'. #5: title='leer paper topos', when=next Friday, priority=P1, tags=[topologia, paper], references contains 'chatgpt' and 'grothendieck'. No field invented. No bullet merged or dropped.

evals.name: single-prose-no-bullets
evals.prompt: escribe un esbozo del ensayo sobre topos de Grothendieck para el viernes que viene, refs: ver mis reflexiones en 04_Research y el libro SGA 4
evals.expected_output: Exactly 1 task. title contains 'esbozo' and 'topos' (verbatim from user; no rewriting). when = next Friday ISO date. references contains 'reflexiones en 04_Research' and 'SGA 4'. priority=null, tags=[], project=null, time_of_day=null, duration_min=null.

evals.name: numbered-list-english-sparse
evals.prompt:
todo list:
1. review PR #342
2. ping alice about the DB migration
3. P0 FIX the prod outage
4. lunch
evals.expected_output: Exactly 4 tasks. All with when=today (no date given). #1: title='review PR #342' — note '#342' is NOT a tag (no letter after #), it should be kept in the title verbatim. #2: title='ping alice about the DB migration'. #3: title='FIX the prod outage', priority=P0. #4: title='lunch'. All tags=[], priority=null except #3.

evals.name: close-task-by-id
evals.expected_output: Updates task id=2026-04-22-001 to status=done, stamps closed_at=current ISO datetime. aggregate.py re-runs and Weekly/Monthly reflect the new completion. No new tasks created.

evals.name: query-open-P0s
evals.prompt: qué tareas P0 tengo abiertas este mes?
evals.expected_output: Invokes query_tasks.py with --status open --priority P0 --since <first-of-month>. Returns a markdown table; no writes to the ledger. If no matches, returns '_no matches_'.

evals.name: block-with-reason
evals.prompt: bloquea la tarea de la migración de la BD, servidor storengy caído desde ayer y no sabemos cuándo vuelve
evals.expected_output: Fuzzy-match finds task with title matching 'migración' and 'BD' (or asks to disambiguate if multiple). Sets status=blocked, body appends/sets the blocker description. Never stamps closed_at. aggregate reflects it in Weekly under 'blocked'.
